methodology: Pure Rep4 ring32 GPU activation protocols with checked CUDA phase graphs and probabilistic truncation. Live samples draw fresh masks. Device-delivered isolated-party replay reproduces one recorded transcript for timing only; its estimate excludes network latency/bandwidth. Inputs are public bounded fixtures privately shared; range is a caller contract, with no private clipping/check. Quadratic uses the existing uniform or local plan (mixed profile selects local); higher degrees use normalized even Horner with reduced internal precision and Q14 output. Interval integer oracle covers every floor/ceil rounding outcome. No full FFN or language-model quality claim.
